description: This Java class defines a custom preference component for Android, named BrandedSwitchPreference. It extends SwitchPreferenceCompat to add branding capabilities, such as applying a main color to the switch widget. The class handles view binding, applying styles, and recursively locating the MaterialSwitch widget within the preference view hierarchy.

classes.name: BrandedSwitchPreference
classes.description: A custom switch preference that supports branding by applying a main color to the switch widget, extending SwitchPreferenceCompat.

methods.description: Applies the specified color to the switch widget as part of branding.
